qs.q: Which of the following structures contributes to the static stability of the ankle joint?
qs.e: The deltoid ligament provides vital static stability on the medial side of the ankle joint, alongside the mortise structure and other collateral ligaments. Tendons crossing the joint provide dynamic rather than static stability.
